root_idea.summary: A root centered on reaching, catching up with, and arriving at another; it also extends to joining, attaching, and associating.
root_idea.development: The basic idea of attaining and reaching develops into following or overtaking, causing someone or something to join another, and broader senses of adherence and adjunction.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect-tense dictionary citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form IV perfect-tense dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To catch up with, reach, or join another person or group.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for attaining or coming up with others; the Quranic occurrences describe people who have or have not yet joined another group.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to reach, join, or follow another.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative construction used when a person or group is brought into connection with another person, group, or destination.

senses.definition: To attach or associate one thing with another, classing it with or treating it as comparable to the other.
senses.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ for making something an adjunct, associate, or putative equal of another; in the Quran it occurs in the association of partners with God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overtake or befall someone, especially of grief or another event; to ensue for him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A use in which an event or affliction is the subject and its effect comes upon a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become, or make oneself, on a par with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or parity construction describing equal standing or apparent equality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become adjoined or annexed to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for attachment or incorporation into another thing, apart from the Quranic personal or group-joining construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be firmly compacted, coherent, or knit together, with parts inserted into one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the physical cohesion or interlocking of several parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the price or payment to become obligatory upon someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression concerning the incurring of liability for a price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a punishment or affliction to overtake or befall someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of making an imposed punishment reach the person upon whom it falls.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to reach a place; to remove or transfer him to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative reaching construction whose destination is a place rather than another person or group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affiliate someone to another as a son, or attach him to that person as a claimed relation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported affiliation is associated with mutual likeness and may concern a claimed or attached son.
A nominal use equated with remaining attached or clinging.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Lean or lank in the sides; likewise, in the expression لَاحِقُ البَطْنِ, lank in the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Conventional descriptive expressions for a slender build.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The grammatical process of rendering a word quasi-coordinate with another word whose radical letters are more numerous, including adding a letter for that purpose.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical term; a letter added for this function is حَرْفُ إِلْحَاقٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A word treated as quasi-coordinate with a word having more radical letters; hence a quasi-quadriliteral word.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical classification, with plural مُلْحَقَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overtake one another or come up with one another in succession.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a group whose later members catch up with its earlier members, as in the reported expression for saddle-camels.
An adjectival use equated with مُتَعَاوِنٌ.
